name: passageway
description: Retrieval for Claude over MCP: connectors feed passages, a relevance gate keeps it quiet when nothing fits. Ships the prompt hook and the skills /passageway (a general guide), /passageway-install (install and run it as a service), /passageway-connect (link Claude Code to a server), /passageway-add-source (index a source), /passageway-evaluate (measure retrieval quality on the user's questions) and /create-passageway-connector (write a connector).
